caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #68: CAJOLE

cajole (verb): to persuade through gentle urging or flattery.

✅ In a sentence: She cajoled her brother into helping her move by promising to buy pizza.
✅ Similar: coax, wheedle, sweet-talk
✅ Remember it: Persuasion by sweetness, not force (compare: coerce).
